rawContent: During the 2013 acquittal of #TrayvonMartin murder, three Black women created an organization, @Blklivesmatter with a mission to eradicate white supremacy and build local power to intervene in violence inflicted on Black Communities. We celebrate #BLM this #WomensHERstory Month https://t.co/A4Iw4Vr1S6

We’re still celebrating #WomensHERstory. Today we honor @TaranaBurke, the founder of the #MeToo movement. Burke was awarded @Time Magazine's person of the year and named one of Time’s most influential people of 2018. https://t.co/7UEECfV7Vd
